counterargs.read: The broad liquidity/credit/vol tape is calm-to-improving, but that's measuring the wrong thing for today's actual news: a SanDisk-guidance-triggered memory-chip demand scare that hit Korea hard (sidecar halt) while barely denting US semis (SOXX -2.1%) or index vol (VIX 15.99). That gap is worth watching — if US semis start confirming the Korea move over the next session or two, this becomes a genuine chain-wide inflection rather than a one-country reaction.
